message.content: monokl CI: several breakages came from PRs that were each green but broke main when merged together (e.g. a deleted struct field used by a test in another PR). Trail 366 "Every merge is verified together". Task: make CI verify the combined state without human ceremony. Inspect .github/workflows/ci.yml (and callisto-release.yml, which is GENERATED by Callisto 0.20 — do not hand-edit it; check `scripts/check-drift.sh`) and the justfile `ci` recipe. Options: add a `merge_group` trigger to the CI jobs so a GitHub merge queue runs them on the combined commit (the user will enable the queue in repo settings; that is the only human step); and a post-merge job on push to main that runs the same checks and fails loudly (plus, if cheap, opens or comments an issue only on failure). Keep it minimal: reuse the existing jobs; no new bureaucracy; no extra required checks beyond what is needed. Check that all required-status job names stay stable (a queue needs the same checks reported on merge_group). Pin new action SHAs the way the repo does, run `just zizmor`, `just check-drift`, `just ci` and judge by exit code. Write in the PR body exactly which repo settings the user must flip (merge queue, required checks) in 3 bullets. No changeset (tooling; run `just changesets` to confirm). Ownership: .github/workflows/ci.yml, justfile (ci recipe only), CONTRIBUTING.md if it describes CI. Git: isolated worktree; never touch `.claude/settings.json`; `git switch -c ci/verify-combined-main origin/main` first; Conventional Commits; commit messages end with `Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01AdtWVgDi4y4qCnpfdozb2n`; push; `entire trail link 366 --branch ci/verify-combined-main --base main` (never trail create / gh pr create / force-push); `gh pr ready`; PR description ends with `https://claude.ai/code/session_01AdtWVgDi4y4qCnpfdozb2n`. name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
  RUST_BACKTRACE: 1

# Each job runs `just` recipes, so `just ci` locally does what CI does.
jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: clippy,rustfmt
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2.90.1
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-machete,typos
      - run: just lint doc-check machete typos

  test:
    name: Test / ${{ matrix.os }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2.90.1
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest
      - run: just test

  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: msrv
        run: echo "version=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.msrv.outputs.version }}
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --all-features --locked

  coverage:
    name: Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - id: rust
        run: |
          version=$(sed -n 's/^rust = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' .prototools)
          test -n "$version"
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ steps.rust.outputs.version }}
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2.90.1
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-nextest,cargo-llvm-cov
      - run: just coverage
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        if: always()
        with:
          name: coverage
          path: lcov.info
          retention-days: 14

  audit:
    name: Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@c509219cf42fba86913069efd0ade2458c59337b # v2.90.1
        with:
          tool: just,cargo-deny,zizmor@1.29.0
      - run: just deny zizmor check-drift

  changesets:
    name: Changesets
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/callisto/.github/actions/callisto-validate@aebeedcdaa1dce8f0d9ad1836844ab6be68daf1f # callisto@0.20.0

  # The one check to require in branch protection.
  ci:
    name: CI
    needs: [lint, test, msrv, coverage, audit, changesets]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - if: contains(needs.*.result, 'failure') || contains(needs.*.result, 'cancelled')
        run: exit 1

p='.github/workflows/ci.yml'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("  cancel-in-progress: true\n","  # Every commit on main keeps its own run, so a red one is never hidden by the next merge.\n  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}\n")
s+='''
  # Runs only after a merge. The merge queue should keep main green; this catches whatever slips past it.
  main-red:
    name: Main is red
    needs: [ci]
    if: always() && github.event_name == 'push' && needs.ci.result == 'failure'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      issues: write
    steps:
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
          SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          body="CI failed on main at $SHA: $RUN_URL"
          number=$(gh issue list --label ci-red --state open --json number --jq '.[0].number // empty')
          if [ -n "$number" ]; then
            gh issue comment "$number" --body "$body"
          else
            gh label create ci-red --color B60205 --description "CI failed on main" 2>/dev/null || true
            gh issue create --label ci-red --title "CI is red on main" --body "$body"
          fi
          echo "::error::$body"
          exit 1
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
